# Break-glass + backups

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P1 · Who did it](../README.md#phase-1--who-did-it) · **Lane:** Control plane · **Label:** `feature:ops-hardening` · **Epic:** [#55](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/55) · **Tickets:** 3 (1S 2M)

Operators get a local emergency admin login for when Dex is down. It is disabled by default, password-hashed, and loud on every use. The CP also takes scheduled consistent SQLite backups of all its state, with a tested restore runbook and a production readiness guide.

## How we build it

- `console.breakGlass: {enabled: false, username, passwordHashEnv}` takes an argon2id PHC string from env (golang.org/x/crypto/argon2). Login is at `POST /auth/breakglass` and is rate-limited to 5 per 15 min per IP. The session has role admin, auth_method `breakglass` and a 1h absolute lifetime.
- On every break-glass login attempt, successful or not, the CP writes an admin audit entry and publishes an `integration.Finding` with RuleID `breakglass_login` and critical severity through the CP alert pipeline. The dashboard shows a red banner for the session.
- Backups: `--backup-dir`, `--backup-interval` (default 24h) and `--backup-keep` (default 7) run `VACUUM INTO` for warden-cp.db, warden-fleet.db and warden-alerts.db into timestamped files, write a sha256 manifest, and prune old sets. A failure logs an error and raises a `backup_failed` Finding.
- Restore: `warden control-plane restore --from <backup-set> --state-dir <dir>` verifies the manifest and integrity_check and refuses to run while the CP holds the DB lock. The audit key and served config.yaml are listed as separate files the operator must back up.

## Done when

With Dex stopped, an operator who enabled break-glass can log in as admin, which raises an alert and an audit row. A nightly backup set restores into a fresh state dir and the CP starts with identical policy head, tokens and audit chain.

### 1/3 · W-P1-OPS1-01

**Add break-glass local admin with alerting and audit**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#56](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/56)

Extend `ConsoleConfig` with `BreakGlass{Enabled, Username, PasswordHashEnv}`, and fail validation if it is enabled without a valid argon2id hash. Add a `POST /auth/breakglass` handler with constant-time username compare, argon2id verify, and an IP rate limiter. On success it creates a 1h admin session with auth_method `breakglass`. Every attempt publishes a `breakglass_login` Finding via the pipeline bus and writes an admin audit row. Add `warden control-plane hash-password` to produce the PHC string.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Disabled by default: the route returns 404 when not enabled
- [ ] A successful login yields an admin session and exactly one critical Finding plus one audit row
- [ ] A sixth failed attempt within 15 min returns 429

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-SSO-04`](console-sso-rbac.md#46--w-p1-sso-04) Add server-side sessions, logout, /auth/me and CSRF; [`W-P1-AAUD-02`](admin-audit-log.md#23--w-p1-aaud-02) Record every CP mutation via audit middleware with state hashers

**Unblocks:** [`W-P1-OPS1-03`](ops-hardening.md#33--w-p1-ops1-03) Write backup/restore runbook and production readiness guide

### 2/3 · W-P1-OPS1-02

**Add scheduled SQLite backups and verified restore command**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#57](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/57)

Add `internal/controlplane/backup.go`: a ticker running `VACUUM INTO '<dir>/<ts>/<name>.db'` for each CP DB, a `manifest.json` with sha256 and size, and pruning to `--backup-keep` sets. Failures emit a `backup_failed` Finding. Add a `restore` subcommand that checks the manifest hash, runs `PRAGMA integrity_check`, refuses if the target DB is locked, and copies files into place.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] A backup taken while writes are in flight passes integrity_check
- [ ] Restoring into an empty state dir and starting the CP serves the same /policy ETag and verifies the admin audit chain
- [ ] A tampered backup file fails restore with a manifest mismatch

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-SSO-01`](console-sso-rbac.md#16--w-p1-sso-01) Add internal/cpstate SQLite state store with migrations

**Unblocks:** [`W-P1-OPS1-03`](ops-hardening.md#33--w-p1-ops1-03) Write backup/restore runbook and production readiness guide
